newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kokusai Kogyo down after Janome stake announcement.
newsitem.headline: Kokusai Kogyo down after Janome stake announcement.

text.p: Shares in Kokusai Kogyo Co Ltd fell sharply on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Tuesday morning after Janome Sewing Machine Co Ltd announced that it had bought about 15 million shares in Kokusai from one of Janome's units.
By 0114 GMT, Kokusai shares were down 60 yen at 1,120.
"Kokusai shares closed 100 yen higher on Monday on speculation about a large-lot transaction made on Monday morning," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
"And there was an announcement (by Janome) on the transactions after the close that is pushing down Kokusai shares," he said.
Janome said on Monday that a credit company in which it holds a 19 percent share, and to which it has extended a loan of 28.6 billion yen, is expected to be liquidated by the end of March.
Janome said the loan would be repaid in part by 16.9 billion yen that Janome paid the credit company to purchase 15 million shares in Kokusai. Janome had held the shares as collateral for the loan.
